answer: Periodic Personhood Beacon 1) New users stake 50 OPAL tokens to join. 2) A randomly selected group of 100 existing members, the tide, reviews new applications. 3) Successful applicants receive a unique, time-limited digital wharf, expiring every 30 days. Re-attestation requires a 10 OPAL fee. Cost for N identities is roughly 50N + 10(N-1) OPAL initially, plus 10 OPAL per re-attestation cycle. A stake of 5000 OPAL allows 100 identities.
